1590:### `cloud eval run`
1591-
1592-Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned
suite file and run it. Provide **either** `--suite` **or** `--file`, not both.\n1593-\n1594-By default the command prints a launch
receipt and returns immediately. `--wait` polls every launched run to a terminal state.\n1595-\n1596-**Exit codes (`--wait` only)
.** Without `--wait` this command's exit code is unchanged: `0` on any launch, `1` on a partial or wholly failed fan-out. `--wait`
owns a separate six-code contract — a caller who asked this process to sit and watch a run to completion is asking it to say how

the run went:
1597-
1598-| Code | Meaning |
1599-| - | - |
1600-| `0` | Every waited run passed, unanimously, and (when a repo
rt was requested) every report was assembled |\n1601-| `1` | A run **completed** with a **failed** verdict. The only condition tha
t produces this code |\n1602-| `2` | Usage error — bad flags, `--reporter`/`--out` without `--wait`, or an invalid suite file (aft
er auth, before any server/model work) |\n1603-| `3` | Auth failed — no credential, or the platform rejected it, at launch or mid-
wait (a token that expired during a long poll). Zero credits spent if it happened before launch |\n1604-| `4` | Connection/setup f
ailed before evaluation — a launch failure this CLI itself observed (network, timeout, rate limit, a partial or failed fan-out, an
unrecognized launch error), or a local `--out` write failure — unless a more severe outcome (`1` or `3`) already applies to the s
ame run, per the merge order above |\n1605-| `5` | No valid verdict — `inconclusive`, a null/unrecognized result, a run whose own
status is failed/cancelled/timed-out, a wait that hit its deadline, a mid-wait failure that was not auth-shaped, or a report that
could not be assembled |\n1606-\n1607-No infrastructure condition ever maps to `1` — see the same rule under `eval gate` below. A
multi-target launch merges these worst-of across every waited run, in the order `1 > 3 > 4 > 5 > 0`: a real verdict failure is nev
er masked by a sibling's infrastructure noise, and a credential failure (which may be *why* other targets show no verdict) outrank
s a plain connection failure.\n1608-\n1609-This six-code contract is new and deliberately **different** from `eval gate`'s four co
des below — see that command's own doc for why the two are not unified. An invalid suite file exits **2** either way — `eval valid
ate` still exits 1 for the same contract failure, because it is a verdict on the file and this command is not.\n1610-\n1611-| Flag

| Required | Description |
1612-| - | - | - |
1613-| `--suite <id-or-name>` | Yes, unless `--file` | Eval suite name or ID |
1
614-| `--file <path>` | Yes, unless `--suite` | Versioned suite file to upload and run (`.yaml` or `.json`, or `-` for stdin) |\n1
615-| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project) |\n1616-| `--server <id-o
r-name...>` | No | Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only) |\n1617-| `--environment <id-or-name...>` | No
| Attached project environment(s) to run. Several values start one **paid run each**. |\n1618-| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No |
Attached client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several values start one **paid run each**. |\n1619-|
`--host <id-or-name...>` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--client`. Passing both is an error. Not the host-compat catalog id `mcp
jam compat --host` / `mcpjam tools --host` take — see [Two different `--host` flags](#two-different---host-flags). |\n1620-| `--al
l-targets` | No | Run **every** attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one **paid run per target** |\n1621-| `-
-iterations <n>` | No | Run each case this many times (1-10), for this run only |\n1622-| `--repetitions <n>` | No | **Legacy** sp
elling of `--iterations`. Passing both is an error. |\n1623-| `--case <id-or-title...>` | No | Run only these cases instead of the
whole suite |\n1624-| `--exclude-skills` | No | Run the \"without skills\" A/B arm: nothing is pinned, and the run is labelled as
excluded |\n1625-| `--refresh-snapshot` | No | **Persists a new host-config snapshot on the suite** (see below). Single-target ru
ns only. |\n1626-| `--notes <text>` | No | Free-text note stored on the run |\n1627-| `--min-pass-rate <n>` | No | Pass threshold
for this run (0-100), overriding the suite's own |\n1628-| `--match-options <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e
.g. `'{\"toolCallOrder\":\"exact\"}'` |\n1629-| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file
`, a fresh key is minted and printed on every invocation when this flag is omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run

instead of starting a new one |
1630-| `--wait` | No | Wait for every launched run to reach a terminal status |
